'''Urgrec''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]'s [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]], supplying the beast pens with fresh creatures. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Nem'ro sought to acquire a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] for himself upon learning that his rival [[Voontara Fa'athra]] had acquired a rancor egg, and Urgrec hired outside help in stealing Fa'athra's rancor egg for Nem'ro.
